<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/create-objectstack/README.md`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/created-summary.ts`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e108996bd44e62dcf0dfbdeebf11398b955827c8` — the merge of head `610d0c6adf1f7f880812207ce9035bd042007de1` into base `6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e108996bd44e62dcf0dfbdeebf11398b955827c8 && git checkout e108996bd44e62dcf0dfbdeebf11398b955827c8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17 610d0c6adf1f7f880812207ce9035bd042007de1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17 && git merge --no-ff 610d0c6adf1f7f880812207ce9035bd042007de1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6f4c518b012a3959ba6c7d414b5fa085ad135c17` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `610d0c6adf1f7f880812207ce9035bd042007de1`
Local-runs: probe — `npm view` of `@objectstack/skills` and `create-objectstack` (versions, dist-tags, dependencies), the brief's one allowed registry read; nothing built, run or re-run

Isolated review at this tier, owed because the diff edits `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` (`domain:spec`, declared after dispatch) from a `domain:cli` claim; the whole PR is judged. Inputs: card #22659 (body and all five comments: the hold, the unlock, claim `6142493926`, the `os-dev-report` `6144849147`, and ACCEPT `6144918545` read as a claim under test), the ruling record `6096124407` on #22649, #22658 and PR #22691, PR #23248's body and 13-file list, the net diff of `refs/pull/23248/head` against merge-base `8024e1243a` (+857 / -363), the registry probe above, and the check-runs on the head. Reading time: 2026-10-13T12:03Z.

**Gate verdicts on the head** (latest run per name, 42 names): 32 success, 9 skipped, 1 in progress at the reading (`Test Core (3/6)`); 0 failed. `Scaffold with repo dist` is success with all 18 steps success, step 15 (pinned shape, now scaffolded without `--skip-skills`) and the new step 16 among them. The check-run's annotations hold no `::warning::` from either step's degraded branch (the only annotation is the runner-image migration notice), so step 16 took its full equality path against the registry-installed `@objectstack/skills@18.0.0-next.0`, not the window's exit 0. `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Validate Package Dependencies`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` family, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`: success. Job log text is not readable from this container (the log store is refused at the proxy); the step-level reading is from the steps list and the annotations.

### ① Derived judgments

**The workflow edit (`.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`) — right.**
- Faithful to the Done-when: `skills_in` lists the immediate subdirectories holding a `SKILL.md`, symlinks excluded, for `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills` and for `.claude/skills`; sorted-string equality is names AND count; an empty catalog is red ("the layout the scaffolder reads has moved"); and `.agents` present or any symlink under `.claude` is red (copied, never linked). That is "the installed skill set equals the package's catalog (count and names)", read off the registry-installed package, never this checkout's `skills/`.
- No loosening: step 14's `run:` is byte-unchanged (comment only, now naming the GitHub path as the `next` channel it guards); step 15's `run:` changes in exactly one token, `--skip-skills` dropped from the scaffold line, and its three-way registry classification, FROM-tag equality and degraded-shape assertion all stand.
- Degradation, evidenced not blanket: the new step probes nothing itself. Its exit-0 branch is reachable only when the skills package is absent AND `@objectstack/cli` is absent AND `.claude/skills` does not exist; because steps run in sequence, that state survives only step 15's warn-and-continue branch (registry reachable, range unsatisfiable); an unreachable registry or a satisfiable range already red step 15. The degraded shape (no skills from any source) is asserted, and a resolved CLI without the skills package reds as a lost dependency. Same shape as the pinned-shape step, inherited through the step order rather than re-probed; sound.
- Network: yes, step 15 now runs `npx -y skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync …`, a fetch of the skills CLI from npm the pinned-probe leg did not make before. The scaffolder swallows a failed fetch (warning "Skills installation failed. Run manually", null, exit 0), so step 15 stays green and step 16 then reds on "the skills the scaffolder installed are not the installed package's catalog". Direction right (fails closed; this workflow's own rule is that an unclassifiable answer is never evidence of a window; no false green exists), but the message names a scaffolder defect where the cause may be the CLI fetch; the real cause sits one step up, in the scaffolder's own warning in step 15's output. Not new to the job: step 14 already runs `npx -y skills add` unpinned against npm and GitHub with no classification at all. Note-level, not a FAIL: a re-run disambiguates.
- New gate? No. The card's Done-when names this assertion, and the card is execution card ③ of ruling `6096124407`, whose workload line names "`skills-install.ts` and its e2e" as the cli lane's precedent. The assertion lands as one step inside an existing pipeline job whose header still reads `dispatch-gates: no-check-families`; no check family, workflow, patrol line or ratchet joins the roster. The doctrine "new gates default to no" (pm-dispatch skill) governs the roster, and the roster is unchanged.

**The installer — right.**
- Pin: `skills@1.7.2`, the version measured against the PUBLISHED `18.0.0-next.0` tarball. Pinning an `experimental_` command is right: the destination layout is that CLI's to choose, and an unpinned `npx skills` would move it under every scaffold silently. The hermetic stub writes `MEASURED_CLI` out rather than importing it and refuses the unpinned argv with exit 3 (case "refuses an argv it has no measured shape for"), so moving the pin without re-measuring reds the e2e. The cost is in the open: the pin is baked into every scaffolded `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`, which keep working as long as 1.7.2 stays on npm.
- Outcome verification replaces the exit code: `installSkillsFromPackage` reads the catalog out of `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills` BEFORE the sync (no version or empty catalog: warning, null) and AFTER it requires every catalog name to be a real directory in `.claude/skills/` (`listSkills` reads `Dirent.isDirectory`, so a symlink is not counted) AND a `skills-lock.json` entry with `source: @objectstack/skills` and `sourceType: node_modules` (`skillsSyncedFromPackage`). That closes both measured exit-0 lies: "Nothing to sync." with no package, and a skipped `skills add` copy whose directory is present but whose lock entry says github. Sound.
- Silent paths: none. The four failure returns (install did not complete; no catalog; `execSync` threw; incomplete after the sync) each print a warning carrying the remedy and return null; the summary then prints the "AI Skills (recommended)" block and never "Installed for". The hermetic suite pins three of them (no catalog; a skipped legacy skill reported as "1 of 3 skill(s)"; `--skip-install`), and the two ablations (template dependency dropped: 10 of 22 red; installer pointed back at GitHub: 13 of 22 red) agree with the stub's refusals.
- Edge not closed and not required: scaffolding into a directory already holding a package-synced `.claude/skills` from an older package version passes the lock check (the lock's `version` is not compared); the sync overwrites `node_modules`-sourced entries on re-run (measured idempotent), so no stale copy survives. Note only.

**The dependency — right.**
- `@objectstack/skills` joins the blank template's `devDependencies` at `^18.0.0`, rewritten at scaffold time by `syncObjectStackDeps` (walks `dependencies` AND `devDependencies` for `@objectstack/*`, pinned by its own unit test) to `^` plus the scaffolder's own version — the range `@objectstack/spec` gets; the e2e asserts the two ranges equal. `devDependencies` is the right field: the catalog is consumed only by the skills CLI at development time; the copied `.claude/skills/` is committed, so a clone needs no install at all; the template's Dockerfile build stage installs from the lockfile (every field) and its runtime stage copies only `dist/objectstack.json`; `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/verify` sit in the same field. `experimental_sync` discovers that field (the real run and CI step 16 synced 10 skills from it).
- `create-objectstack@17.7.0` (`latest`) is a published, immutable tarball: `npm view` reads its dependencies unchanged (`chalk`, `commander`), and this PR writes nothing to it, so a scaffold from `npm create objectstack` keeps the GitHub `skills add` path and no `@objectstack/skills` — unchanged, as required. `create-objectstack@18.0.0-next.0` (`next`) is likewise untouched until the next fixed-group prerelease carries this diff. `@objectstack/skills` on the registry: versions `0.0.0-stage` and `18.0.0-next.0`, dist-tags `latest` and `next` both `18.0.0-next.0` — triage's unlock reading and the dev's hold.
- No lockfile change is owed (the template is not a workspace member); `Validate Package Dependencies` success.

**The removed text — right.**
- `SKILLS_CATALOG` and `skillsAddArgs`: zero readers remain at the head (`git grep` over the tree). The published entry: `create-objectstack`'s manifest exposes `bin` (`dist/index.js`) and an `exports` map naming only `./created-summary`; `dist/skills-install.js` ships under `files: dist` but is sealed by that map, so no consumer could ever import the constant. Not a published export.
- The old command `skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills` survives only where it describes the GitHub `next` channel the ruling keeps: `content/docs/**` (devx lane, #22668), `packages/skills/README.md`, `skills/README.md`, script and workflow comments, CHANGELOG history, and the `template-consistency` grep test, whose population is still non-vacuous (it greps `content/docs`, `skills` and `packages/create-objectstack` for the root-install spelling). No code reader is broken. The scaffolder's run, its summary, both guides it writes and this package's README now name the package command; the new `template-consistency` case holds all three to the exact command the scaffolder runs, pin included, and the `starter-comments` regex follows.

**The four surface-extension files — required by the Done-when, and in-lane.**
- `src/templates/AGENTS.md` and `src/templates/blank/README.md` are files the scaffolder writes into every project; "the GitHub command disappears from the scaffolder's output" cannot hold while the scaffolder writes that command into the project's own guides.
- `template-consistency.test.ts` imported the deleted `SKILLS_CATALOG` (the suite does not compile without the edit); `starter-comments-self-contained.test.ts` pinned the README's old command. All four live under `packages/create-objectstack/`, the card's `domain:cli` surface. The ACCEPT's claim that they are in-lane is tested and holds.

**Other derived judgments.**
- `created-summary.test.ts`: the phase-3 layout follows the new installer (one real tree `.claude/skills/`, plus the catalog under `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills`), and the symlink-counting property moves into a tree of its own instead of being dropped. Right. `created-summary.ts` is comment-only.
- `--skip-skills` keeps its meaning (install runs, no sync, the summary recommends the command); `--skip-install` runs no sync and prints "Not installed yet … After `pnpm install`:" with the command — both as the Done-when reads, both pinned end to end.
- No `skills/**`, no `.claude/**`, no governed path (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` carries no workflow row); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. The head repo is the base repo (not a fork); the PR is a draft with `needs:contract-review`.

### ② Semver level

`create-objectstack: minor`, `Clause-②: no`, no arm, no `!` — right under Post-Task Checklist step 3. A functional change to a released package (a scaffolded project's dependency set and the scaffolder's output change) is a feature-level entry, never `patch` and never `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no` holds: nothing a consumer authors (a spec key, an export, a config field) moves. `SKILLS_CATALOG` is not an export of the published entry (the `exports` map above seals `dist/skills-install.js`), so its deletion is not a narrowing and needs no `(narrowing)`, no `!` and no ADR-0087 disposition; `Check Changeset` success reads the same. The changeset body carries the migration an upgrading project greps for (add the dependency at the spec range, remove the `skills add` copies, re-sync with `--copy`). The fixed group of 71 moves together; that is the group's design, not a cost this PR adds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared; none found.
- `deviations`, each answered:
  1. Surface conflict (the four files): required and in-lane (①); the ACCEPT added them to the claim. The dev proceeded instead of stopping on the breach the claim named, but declared it in the report and the PR body, and the set is the minimum the Done-when forces. Answered.
  2. Ablation overlapping six lock-free gates: all six re-ran clean at exit 0, and the head's check-runs are the verdicts of record regardless. Answered.
  3. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit code not captured on the first run: re-run with capture at exit 0; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success on the head. Answered.
  4. Lock-free full build by `check:type-check-debt`: the dev role file keeps `check:*` gates outside the verify lock by rule; no contaminated reading is claimed, and CI's own build and tests are the record. Answered.
  5. Zero label writes: right; the seat added `needs:contract-review`.
- Carried-not-filed, two:
  1. The docs and `packages/skills/README.md` give the linked sync without `--copy`, which leaves a project that commits its skills with dangling links into the ignored `node_modules` (measured in this PR), carried by #22668. Prime Directive #10 files a reproducible defect, and this is one, with its repro; carrying it is acceptable ONLY while #22668 is open to carry it, and the PR body says #22668's docs PR #23220 is already on `main`. Escalated to the owning seat: confirm #22668 is open and append the note there before landing; if it closed with #23220, file it under PD #10 with the measurement from the PR body. Not a FAIL on this diff: the defect lives in files this PR does not touch and is not introduced by it.
  2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`'s skills boundary probe measures the GitHub `next` channel, not the scaffolder's path: a coverage gap, not a defect, so an acceptance note is the right carrier; the probe still describes a channel the ruling keeps.
- Cross-lane: the workflow file is the surface this record exists for; judged in ① as the card's own named acceptance inside an existing job.
- CI: one `Test Core` shard (3/6) was still in progress at the reading, with 0 failures among the 41 concluded; this record judges on what concluded. The seat lands only on a fully green head.

## 维护者速读 · PR #23248（#22659）· 受管面 Tier H，等你合并或批准

`domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6` · 2026-10-13T12:18Z。PR 改了 `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`，这个路径属于受管登记里的 `.github/workflows/**`（#23048 起），所以落地档位是 H：你亲手合并，或者 `os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 给出 APPROVED 后由本席上队。

**改了什么**
- `npm create objectstack` 新建的项目，现在把 `@objectstack/skills` 列为依赖，版本跟 `@objectstack/spec` 一致。
- 安装完依赖后，脚手架从这个已装好的包里把技能目录实拷到 `.claude/skills/`（`npx -y skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`），不再从 GitHub main 拉。
- 输出、总结，以及写进新项目的 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md` 里，那条 GitHub 安装命令都去掉了。
- CI 的 `scaffold-e2e` 工作流有两处改动：
  - `pinned-probe` 项目改成按真实用户的方式建，不再加 `--skip-skills`；
  - 新增一步，核对装上的技能和包里的目录名称、数量完全一致，并且没有符号链接。

**为什么改**
- 这是你对 #22649 的裁决 A（「22649 同意 A」）在 cli 车道的这三分之一。
- 以前新项目装的是 GitHub main 上的技能，可能比项目用的平台版本新或旧。现在技能跟着项目自己的平台版本走。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**
- **对现有用户无影响**：`create-objectstack@17.7.0`（latest）不受影响。这个改动从下一个 `next` 预发布版生效，那时会写成 `^18.0.0-next.N`。
- **CI 多一次网络拉取**：工作流新增的那次 `skills@1.7.2` 拉取，如果失败会让 job 变红。这是安全方向的失败，不会出现假绿，原因写在上一步的脚手架警告里。
- **回滚**：revert 本 PR 即可，不涉及数据和迁移。
- **合约审查**：`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 复核 PASS（`6145120134`）。CI 头部全绿，只有 roster 内的预期 skip。

**席位意见**
- 建议合并。代码面、两个 e2e（hermetic 单测和工作流里的 registry 实装）以及消融实验都齐了。
- 唯一的受管点是那个工作流文件，改动正是卡的验收要求（「scaffold e2e 断言装上的技能集合等于包的目录」），不是新加的门禁。
- 席位的失误要说明一下：本席之前用了过期的本地脚本，判成「不受管」，把它转 ready 上了队，被队列的 Governed Surface Guard 拦下（exit 3）。现已退回 draft，关闭自动合并，不再自行上队。

**你要做的（一个动作）**
- 在 PR #23248 上点 Approve，本席随后上队；或者你直接合并。
